title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-27
lineage: PCM -> Peak -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Great soundboard transfer captures a mixed‑energy show with standout jams on Playing in the Band and The Wheel, though Jerry’s playing feels flat
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clear PCM transfer and “phat” sound quality despite originating from a less‑than‑ideal source. Musically the set is described as uneven – a so‑so performance overall with sloppy moments, but high points in Playing in the Band and a sweet Wheel; Jerry’s guitar work is noted as uninspired and The Other One meanders.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is average to below‑average (mixed reviews, some negative comments) while the recording quality is consistently praised as excellent; weighted blend yields a solid 3.5‑4 star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear PCM transfer highlighted as “phat” and well‑executed; reviewers note the source was originally poor but the digitized version is crisp and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Uneven pacing with a few high‑energy jams amid generally sloppy playing; second half picks up with strong improvisation.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Playing described as uninspired and flat
band_member_comments.Phil: Present but no specific praise or criticism
